learningObjectives: Create a structured testing strategy for the AI capstone.
Identify the essential components of technical documentation.
Organize an effective technical project presentation.

activities.title: Build the Testing Strategy
activities.instruction: Explore the testing layers required for an AI capstone.

content.concept: AI projects benefit from testing data validation, preprocessing, model behavior, APIs, and end-to-end workflows.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Verify that input data is complete, valid, and within expected ranges.
Check that cleaning and feature transformations produce the expected outputs.
Evaluate model predictions, metrics, and behavior on representative inputs.
Verify request validation, response formats, status codes, and error handling.
Check that application components communicate correctly with each other.
Validate the complete workflow from user input through AI processing to the final result.

activities.title: Explore Documentation Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the purpose of each technical documentation section.

content.concept: Useful AI documentation explains the problem, data, model, architecture, setup, usage, and limitations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Explains the problem the capstone is designed to solve.
Shows how the frontend, backend, data pipeline, and AI components interact.
Describes the data source, structure, preprocessing, and relevant characteristics.
Documents the selected algorithm, training approach, and evaluation metrics.
Explains the dependencies, environment, and steps required to run the project.
Shows how users or developers interact with the completed system.
Summarizes tests performed and the observed results.
Documents known constraints, failure cases, and areas where the system may not perform reliably.
Describes realistic ways the project could be extended or improved.

activities.title: Sequence the Presentation
activities.instruction: Arrange the presentation sections into a logical technical story.

content.concept: A technical presentation can progress from problem and solution to architecture, implementation, results, and future improvements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Validate Project Readiness
activities.instruction: Select the items that should be checked before the final demonstration.

content.concept: A capstone should be checked for functionality, reproducibility, documentation, error handling, and demonstration readiness.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Demo data and workflow are ready
